_comment: Template for the per-checkout, gitignored dev.local.json. Copy it (`cp default.dev.local.json dev.local.json`) and give EACH parallel checkout distinct values — see the 'Parallel test isolation' section in docs/testing.md for the recommended per-checkout table. Every key is optional; an omitted key falls back to a default that reproduces the historical single-checkout behaviour exactly. The values shown here are 'checkout 0'.
